name: IBY_INBOUND_FILE
description: Stores files received from external payment systems such as payment acknowledgments or bank statements.

columns.name: INBOUND_FILE_ID
columns.description: System-generated primary key.

columns.name: INBOUND_FILE
columns.description: Inbound file contents as a BLOB. In encrypted form if encryption is turned on.

columns.name: PROCESSING_STATUS
columns.description: Processing status for the inbound file. Values taken from lookup: IBY_INB_FILE_PROC_STATUS

columns.name: FORMAT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Format type of the inbound file.

columns.name: FORMAT_CODE
columns.description: Format of the inbound file.

columns.name: BEPID
columns.description: Payment system that the inbound file is pulled from.

columns.name: TRANSMIT_CONFIG_ID
columns.description: Transmission configuration used for retrieving or receiving the file from the payment system.

columns.name: TRADING_PARTNER_FILE_REF
columns.description: String identifier assigned by the payment system to uniquely identify an inbound file for a time period. For payment acknowledgment this maps to MessageIdentification field in ISO PaymentStatusReportV02.

columns.name: TRADING_PARTNER_FILE_DATE
columns.description: Date/Time stamped on the inbound file by the trading partner.

columns.name: FILE_PATH
columns.description: File path on remote system for FTP protocol family or file path on local file system for local file.  This is not the user-entered parameter, but the actual evaluated value used by the communication component to retrieve the file.

columns.name: FILE_NAME
columns.description: Electronic bank statement file name.

columns.name: FILE_LENGTH
columns.description: Length of the file.

columns.name: ENCRYPTED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if payload is encrypted.

columns.name: COMPRESSED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if payload is compressed

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: Error message.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CES_FLOW_CODE
columns.description: Code of the flow identified by Oracle Connected Partners.

columns.name: CES_SUBFLOW_CODE
columns.description: Code of the sub flow identified by Oracle Connected Partners.

columns.name: CES_VENDOR_CODE
columns.description: Code of the partner stored within Oracle Connected Partners.

columns.name: UCM_DOC_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the document uploaded within Oracle Universal Content Management.
